question.problem:
Which of the following is a stream function for the vector field
$F(x,y)=(1-2xy)\,i-{y}^{2}\,j?$
question.worked_solution:
A vector field $F=P\,i+Q\,j$ with a simply connected domain $D⊆{R}^{2}$ has a stream function $ψ(x,y)$ if and only if

$$
\frac{∂P}{∂x}+\frac{∂Q}{∂y}=0.
$$

Note that $F(x,y)=(1-2xy)\,i-{y}^{2}\,j$ is a vector field with simply connected domain $D={R}^{2},$ where $P(x,y)=1-2xy$ and $Q(x,y)=-{y}^{2}.$ Computing the partial derivatives, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂P}{∂x}=-2y,\,\frac{∂Q}{∂y} & =-2y.\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, $F$ has a no stream function, since

$$
\frac{∂P}{∂x}+\frac{∂Q}{∂y}=-2y+(-2y)=-4y\ne 0.
$$
